scientific_intent.scientific_task: Direct Coulomb electrostatic potential on a planar grid
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Sum atom charge divided by Euclidean distance for each sample, with original4000-atom constant-memory chunks and eight x outputs per lane.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Electrostatic grid evaluation building block; named microbenchmark does not certify full molecular simulation.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Float32 device arithmetic against independent Float64 direct sum; full output, actual inputs and guards plus exact cancellation and zero-charge controls.

native_to_julia_mapping.reason: CUDA8x8 block flattened to64KA/JACC lanes, eight x grid samples per lane; same chunking and ordering. Native rsqrtf versus generic inv(sqrt) is a separate arithmetic covariate.

verification_contract.oracle: Full Float64 Coulomb directsum on raw Float32 atom coordinates and Float32-sampled grid coordinates; analytic1charge,exactpairedcancellation andzerochargecontrols.
verification_contract.scope: Original sourcecenergy bodyunchanged; allsourcechunking(MAXATOMS4000) retained; CPU preprocessing/H2D/reset/observations excluded uniformly. Sum6hosttimed launch+completionfragments over5fixtures; notoriginal1M-atoms768x768wholeCLI or hostpipeline timing.
verification_contract.tolerance_basis: Declared beforefirstexecution forFP32sequentialmixedchargesums/approximate native rsqrt, independentlychecked Float64reference. Sourcecontainsnofullaccuracychecker; nooriginaltoleranceweakened. Zerocharge/cancellation,deviceinputbytesandguards exact.
verification_contract.max_rel_error_definition: abs(error)/max(abs(Float64 physicalreference),2e-4); conditioned diagnostic, independent from atol+rtol acceptance
